lede: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play), while Atlanta Falcons owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#12 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Atlanta Falcons +3.5 with a fair total of 48.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cincinnati Bengals pass offence vs Atlanta Falcons pass defence, which sits +0.099 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
